title: ticfac: execution and orchestration extracted from ticks
description: Project for docs/projects/2026-09-01-ticfac-architecture/SPEC.md. ticks stays the tracker (tk, .tick/, authoring policy); ticfac is a new, separate repository that owns execution and orchestration: a reconciler over two durable authorities (ticks and Git incl. .ticfac/), a four-operation executor protocol (start/inspect/cancel/collect), role jobs for review and closeout, and hosts (local subprocess, Herdr, Cloudflare compatibility, Cloudflare Computer). Migration in gated chunks per SPEC §12: local hosts first, Cloudflare once the reconciler is proven. Each phase is one epic whose final tick is a real gate run. Roadmap-level changes are human decisions.
notes:
2026-09-17 21:17 - 2026-09-17 - The open phases of this ladder MOVED to ticfac's own tracker.

Phases 4, 4b, 5, 6 and 7 (ncv, djo, yvi, ezj, 6in) now live in the ticfac repo as top-level epics beside qeu (Phase 1), av8 (Phase 2) and 9pd (Phase 3), keeping their ids. They were tracked here because the ladder was written before ticfac had a tracker; the consequence was that ticfac's own roadmap showed no Cloudflare work at all, and an operator reading it would conclude none was planned.

The family referenced nothing outside itself and no id collided, so the move was the files plus two re-pointings: the parent (this tick) dropped, and ncv's blocker re-pointed from tw6 to ticfac's 9pd.

What stays here: the closed Phase 0/1/2 records (692, 4ik, jrj) as history - the real children of Phases 1 and 2 were always in ticfac - and tw6, which is still OPEN and is NOT covered by ticfac 9pd. tw6 wants role jobs validated on both executors and the lifecycle loop deleted from the ticks runner. It is a real prerequisite for Phase 4 and it has not moved; ncv carries a note saying so.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] ticks builds and tests without importing or embedding Factory code; ticfac builds against a pinned tk --json release and contract bundle. [A2] ticfac run-epic completes and recovers one epic locally using only tk, Git, the executor protocol, role jobs and evidence commands, with claude, codex and pi as runners on the local subprocess executor and Herdr as a second executor, both passing the same conformance suite. [A3] Authoritative run state lives under .ticfac/ in the repository, pushed on origin at once; a controller restarted from a clone alone reconciles every in-flight attempt and never silently redispatches or declares success from missing state. [A4] Review and closeout run as independently configurable role jobs against the integrated diff and return validated structured results with provenance. [A5] The Cloudflare deployment uses one Workflow per EpicRun hosting the reconciler, a Durable Object as a lock, R2 for logs, no orchestrator coding container, and runs an epic to completion unattended, stopping at a PR that is REVIEWED and CI-VERIFIED for a person to merge (w1z A1 as amended 2026-09-18, through the new reconciler: the run never merges its own PR). [A6] No Factory-specific command, credential, runner or wave supervisor remains in ticks beyond a documented compatibility transition.
closed_reason: Extraction done on the ticks side: phases 0-2 closed here, phases 4-7 moved to ticfac on 2026-09-17, and chz removed what ticfac handles (v0.32.0). Remaining takeover is ticfac 6in
